Premium 6 in 1 Military Plastic Pen with Compass, Torch, Tools, Phone Stand & Stylus

The 6 in 1 Military Plastic Pen with compass, torch, tools, phone stand and stylus is designed for people who value practicality, rugged style, and multi-functional everyday tools. This premium writing instrument is more than just a pen — it is a compact survival accessory crafted for convenience, emergency use, outdoor travel, and daily utility. With a sturdy military-grade design, this premium 6 function military pen with rugged looks stands out as a smart pick for professionals, students, trekkers, adventurers, and corporate gifting requirements.Its multifunctional features ensure that you always have small essential tools at hand, whether you’re working, travelling, or dealing with unexpected situations. Designed in an attractive military green color, it delivers a powerful combination of style, strength, and usability. The strong grip, compact construction, and durable finish make this pen suitable for everyday carry.

One of the key highlights is the integrated stylus and phone stand in the cap, allowing you to operate touchscreens smoothly and enjoy hands-free convenience for videos, calls, or presentations. The built-in compass at the back helps you find directions during travel or outdoor adventures. Below the compass, the pen includes a bright emergency torch that provides instant illumination whenever needed. Additionally, the pen houses a set of two side screwdrivers inside the body, making small fixes simple and accessible without carrying a toolkit.

Whether used for branding, corporate gifting, event giveaways, or personal utility, this multifunction military pen delivers value far beyond a regular writing tool. The blend of rugged appearance, six-in-one utility, and compact portability makes it an excellent addition to everyday essentials.

Key Features of the 6 in 1 Military Plastic Pen

  • Premium 6 function military pen with rugged looks and durable construction
  • Has a stylus and phone stand in the cap for anywhere convenience
  • Compass at the back to find out directions during travel or outdoor use
  • Emergency torch below the compass for instant lighting
  • Two side screwdrivers inside the body for small repairs & adjustments
  • Comes in an attractive and sturdy military green color
  • Ideal for corporate gifts, employee onboarding kits, events & branding

Why Choose This 6 in 1 Military Pen?

This multipurpose writing tool is perfect for users who prefer compact accessories with multiple features. Unlike basic gift pens, this rugged multifunction Ball pen offers a complete blend of practicality and design that appeals to a wide audience. Corporate buyers often prefer it due to its high perceived value and everyday usability. The included compass, torch, stylus, and screwdrivers make it suitable for outdoor environments, desk use, emergency situations, and daily productivity.

The 6 in 1 Military Plastic Pen with compass, torch, tools, phone stand and stylus also stands out for its versatility across various industries, including IT companies, adventure brands, logistics firms, defense-themed events, automobile companies, and travel-related giveaways. Its rugged appearance enhances its appeal, making it a great choice for premium branding and thoughtful business gifting.

With its combination of practical features, durable build, and multifunction capabilities, this premium Ball pen is an all-rounder accessory that supports your lifestyle—whether in office, outdoors, or while travelling.
